teaser.en: A mangrove found mainly on Kenya's south coast, more often a shrub than a tree, with neat white flowers at the high-water mark.
teaser.sw: Mkoko unaopatikana hasa katika pwani ya kusini ya Kenya, mara nyingi kichaka kuliko mti, wenye maua meupe maridadi kwenye alama ya maji makuu.

summary.en: The white-flowered black mangrove is an evergreen shrub or small tree of the landward high-water edge, found in Kenya mainly on the south coast. It is uncommon, and its wood is used for poles, firewood and charcoal.
summary.sw: Kikandaa ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani unaoota ukingoni mwa maji makuu upande wa nchi kavu, na nchini Kenya hupatikana hasa katika pwani ya kusini. Si wa kawaida, na mbao zake hutumika kwa boriti, kuni na mkaa.

about.en:
This is a small mangrove, an evergreen shrub or small tree under 4 metres. Its leaves are small, fleshy and slightly notched at the tip, crowded towards the ends of the twigs. Small white flowers grow in short spikes, followed by little woody fruits.

It has no stilt roots and few obvious breathing roots, so it can look more like a coastal bush than a mangrove.
about.sw:
Huu ni mkoko mdogo, kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani, wenye urefu wa chini ya mita 4. Majani yake ni madogo, manono na yana kibonyeo kidogo kwenye ncha, yamesongamana kuelekea ncha za vitawi. Maua madogo meupe huota katika mashada mafupi, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo magumu kama mti.

Hauna mizizi-mihimili na una mizizi michache ya kupumulia inayoonekana wazi, hivyo unaweza kuonekana zaidi kama kichaka cha pwani kuliko mkoko.

where.en: It grows at the landward high-water edge of the mangroves, mostly on the Kenyan south coast. It is more often found as a shrub than as a tree. Look for it at the back of the mangroves at Gazi Bay or Vanga, where the tidal mud gives way to firmer ground.
where.sw: Huota ukingoni mwa maji makuu upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko, zaidi katika pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. Mara nyingi hupatikana kama kichaka kuliko kama mti. Utaupata nyuma ya mikoko katika Ghuba ya Gazi au Vanga, pale tope la maji kupwa na kujaa linapoishia na ardhi ngumu zaidi kuanza.

uses.en: Its wood makes medium-quality firewood and charcoal, and its stems are cut for poles.
uses.sw: Mbao zake hutoa kuni na mkaa wa ubora wa wastani, na mashina yake hukatwa kwa ajili ya boriti.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *kikandaa* or *mkandaa mwitu*, the 'wild *mkandaa*', and it is also called *mkaa pwani*. *Mkandaa* is also the Swahili name for the yellow mangrove. In English it is the white-flowered black mangrove, and its scientific name is *Lumnitzera racemosa*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *kikandaa* au *mkandaa mwitu*, yaani '*mkandaa* wa porini', na pia huitwa *mkaa pwani*. *Mkandaa* pia ni jina la Kiswahili la *yellow mangrove*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white-flowered black mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Lumnitzera racemosa*.

conservation.en: It is uncommon in Kenya. Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Si wa kawaida nchini Kenya. Mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inarejesha msitu.

reason.en: Shares the Swahili name mkandaa and the landward mud
reason.sw: Hushiriki jina la Kiswahili mkandaa na tope la upande wa nchi kavu

reason.en: Another uncommon tree of the mangrove's landward edge
reason.sw: Mti mwingine usio wa kawaida wa ukingo wa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu

reason.en: Grows alongside it at the high-water edge
reason.sw: Huota pamoja nao kwenye ukingo wa maji makuu
